recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血液抹片中整片只看到一顆小淋巴球，沒有嗜中性球，也幾乎找不到血小板，紅血球大致正常大小與顏色、無碎片或球形細胞；這種「空蕩、無特異變化」的抹片反映全血球低下，符合以再生不良性貧血表現的 PNH，需以流式偵測 GPI 缺失族群確認。
features: Only a single small mature lymphocyte in the field; no neutrophils or monocytes (leukopenia)
Platelets markedly decreased, essentially absent in this field
Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic with mild anisocytosis and a rare echinocyte
No schistocytes, spherocytes, polychromasia, nucleated red cells, or blasts
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at higher power shows a paucity of leukocytes, with only a single small mature lymphocyte in the field and no neutrophils or monocytes. Platelets are markedly decreased. Red cells are predominantly normocytic and normochromic with mild anisocytosis and a rare echinocyte, without schistocytes, spherocytes, polychromasia, nucleated red cells, or circulating blasts. Findings are consistent with pancytopenia without specific morphologic abnormalities; in the setting of marrow aplasia, this is compatible with aplastic anemia with a PNH clone, which requires confirmation by high-sensitivity flow cytometry (FLAER/CD24/CD14 on granulocytes and monocytes, CD59 on red cells).

ddx.vs: Shows polychromasia and reticulocytosis with elevated LDH and hemoglobinuria, and a large GPI-deficient clone, whereas this smear lacks evidence of active hemolysis.
Often shows macrocytosis, hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils, or circulating blasts, none of which are seen here.
Presents with pancytopenia and monocytopenia but shows circulating cells with circumferential hairy cytoplasmic projections and splenomegaly.
Pancytopenia is accompanied by macro-ovalocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils.
